results.content:
A recent poll of Hispanic voters in Florida shows that Trump's popularity has waned over the past two years. It found 51% disapproved of Trump’s performance in office, while only 41% approved.

The survey also found that 20% of Hispanics in Florida who voted for Trump in 2024 would not repeat their vote. Miami-Dade, one of the nation's largest counties, is home to 2.8 million people. A large majority, roughly 71%, are Hispanic.
